# Loom Agent

> Loom Agent V1.1 is a TypeScript, CLI-first, durable multi-agent runtime with a public SDK, persisted task graphs, parent-child delegation, approvals, verified execution, a control plane, remote workers, and SQLite recovery.

The current release focus is reliable distribution and unified execution. CLI, SDK, daemon, and bot paths should share the same tool policy, tracing, checkpoint, and recovery guarantees.

The milestone-specific V0.4 descriptions below are historical implementation context; current source, package manifests, and tests are authoritative.
